decisions.reason: Distinguishes the clipboard projection (draft/occurrences, chip = full clipboardText) from the detect-coordinate TokenSpan space (chip = one U+FFFC) via contract and facade citations; normal text and separator spaces keep normal width.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add, walks the capture (first span {0,0} valid in both spaces, second 29 vs 2-char detect text), ties insertReference false to the failed detect splice and the generic changed-composer toast; rules out the rev CAS and real concurrency.

Traces remove passing clipboard-space [0,28) to consumeToken, the ignored false, unconditional records.delete, surviving occurrence and record-miss rendering as unavailable; both symptoms tied to the same mismatch.

Derives detect(c) = c − Σ(length−1) over preceding chips, applies it at insert (all preceding occurrences) and removal (mapped offset + one-char span), keeps the rev guard, and gates record deletion on verb success or a verified snapshot-based fallback; invariant sanity-checked.

Two-successive-paste test with both chips present, removal of a chip with another preceding chip asserting composer/dock/record removed together while the other chip survives; adds declined-consumption, ordering, and empty-again variants; section 5 kept as unscored guidance.
